evidence.name: Screen field: Font of the error text
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Font of the error text" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Font of the error text
sections.description: Sets the typeface for the validation error message shown when an answer is rejected. Leave it on your theme/system font unless you have a specific brand font, and match it to the field's font so the error looks like part of the same form. A consistent error style keeps the screen feeling polished and helps users trust and fix the field fast.
